question:
Figures 1 and 2 show the same scene and are pixel-aligned, though they may differ slightly in compression noise everywhere. At most one local region actually differs between them. The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] with values in [0, 1] (origin at the top-left corner). Which region contains the real difference?
(A) [0.1456, 0.6016, 0.2856, 0.7416]
(B) [0.4030, 0.3192, 0.5430, 0.4592]
(C) [0.0855, 0.3596, 0.2255, 0.4996]
(D) The two figures show no real difference, only compression noise.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
